plan.title: Tokyo Kyoto Osaka Fair Mix 5 Days
plan.summary: Tokyo first for shared food and contrasting modern-temple picks, then Kyoto base with an Osaka evening to cover both wish lists. Each person gets five clear wins plus five shared favourites like Tsukiji, Golden Gai and Kinkaku-ji.
tradeoffs: Alex got nature-temple core with Meiji Shrine, Fushimi Inari, Arashiyama and Nishiki Market, while Sam got nightlife-views core with Senso-ji, Skytree sunset, Gion at Dusk, Dotonbori and Umeda Sky Building.
Sam compromised on temples by doing Fushimi and Meiji early in the day with short visits, and Alex compromised on nightlife by doing Gion and Dotonbori as evening strolls with shared dinners.
Both agreed on Tsukiji Outer Market, Golden Gai, Kinkaku-ji, Philosopher's Path and Shinsekai kushikatsu, so those anchor each day as joint wins.
Alex gave up Nara Day Trip, Minoo Falls Hike and Universal Studios Japan was skipped for Sam to keep the trip to 2 hotels and fit Osaka as an evening hop rather than a full day.
